# Artemis II lifts off from Kennedy Space Center

NASA's Orion spacecraft launched atop the Space Launch System rocket on the first crewed mission of the agency's Artemis campaign.

The Artemis II test flight launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The crew of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen will travel to the Moon and land on its surface.

fault.note: The mission goes around the Moon and back to Earth; nothing supports a landing.
